The '''Committee for the Coordination of Statistical Activities''' ('''CCSA''') is a [[United Nations]] inter-agency forum.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://unstats.un.org/unsd/ccsa|title=CCSA Committee for the Coordination of Statistical Activities |publisher=Unstats.un.org |date= |accessdate=2013-03-25}}</ref> It is composed of international and supranational [[organisation]]s whose mandate includes the provision of statistics. The CCSA promotes inter-agency coordination and cooperation on statistical programmes and consistency in statistical practices and development. 

==Activities==
As a forum of committed members, the CCSA's purpose is to foster good practices in the statistical activities of international and supranational organisations, in accordance with the principles governing international statistical activities.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/statorg/Principles_stat_activities/principles_stat_activities.asp |title=Principles Governing International Statistical Activities |publisher=Unstats.un.org |date= |accessdate=2013-03-25}}</ref> Its members contribute actively to the development of a coordinated global statistical system producing and disseminating high-quality statistics.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-11-12 |title=List of marketing statistics - Why are marketing statistics vital? |url=https://apibit.com/ultimate-list-of-marketing-statistics/ |access-date=2023-11-29 |language=en-US}}</ref> 

The CCSA Secretariat and CCSA website<ref>{{cite web|url=http://unstats.un.org/unsd/accsub-public/workpartner_ccsa.htm |title=United Nations Statistics Division - Committee for the Coordination of Statistical Activities (CCSA) |publisher=Unstats.un.org |date= |accessdate=2013-03-25}}</ref> are hosted by the [[United Nations Statistics Division]] (UNSD). The Committee meets twice a year and is represented by the top level of the statistical services of its member organisations. 

==Membership==
As of 2024 members of the CCSA are:<ref>{{cite web |publisher=United Nations Statistics Division | title=Members| url=https://unstats.un.org/unsd/ccsa/members.cshtml | access-date=9 March 2024}}<!--Checked 2024, unchanged since at least 2014--></ref>

* [[Asian Development Bank]] (ADB)

* [[Caribbean Community]] (CARICOM)

* Statistical Centre for the Cooperation Council for the Arab Countries of the Gulf (GCCSTAT)
* [[Statistical, Economic and Social Research and Training Centre for Islamic Countries]] (SESRIC)

* [[United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women]] (UN-Women)
* [[United Nations Environment Programme]] (UNEP)
* [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees]] (UNHCR)
* [[United Nations Human Settlements Programme]] (UN-Habitat)
* [[United Nations Industrial Development Organization]] (UNIDO)
* Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs of the Secretariat (UNOCHA)
